items.a: The first 30-minute consultation is free. For deep document review, follow-up sessions start at 200 PLN depending on complexity.

items.q: How long does a residence permit take?
items.a: Average time to receive the card - 6-8 months. The statutory deadline for the wojewoda (regional governor) is 90 days, but in Mazowieckie Voivodeship in 2026 decisions realistically take 6-14 months. A clean MOS v2.0 filing with the full document pack lands closer to the lower bound. We accelerate through a ponaglenie (motion to expedite) and, if needed, a skarga na bezczynność (complaint of inaction) to the Voivodeship Administrative Court.
Yes. Clients from other Polish cities and abroad run cases fully online. Notarial power of attorney, a direct channel with your case manager, and a client portal with live statuses.
We analyse the grounds and file an appeal within 14 days. We have successful appeals on TRC, PR, citizenship and international protection - including through the Voivodeship Administrative Court.

items.q: Can I register a company remotely?
items.a: Yes, via S24 (the online KRS portal) with a qualified e-signature (ePUAP / ePodpis - Poland's national e-ID) or by notarial power of attorney. Registration takes 5-10 business days.

items.q: What languages do you work in?
items.a: Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, English. All documents come translated into your language.
